name: Regulatory watchlist digest
summary: On the agreed schedule, counsel and the compliance lead get one dated digest of what was published on the company's own watchlist, from the sources supplied: each new item quoted with its link, every source not checked, and a reading list for counsel. It interprets nothing; counsel decides what applies.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of compliance work, which describes the regulatory watchlist review: an agreed watchlist, the period's items from the agreed sources and the last digest go in; a dated digest with source links, coverage gaps and questions for counsel comes out; counsel decides what applies and the compliance lead assigns follow-up.
